summary: Iteration 61: tested the quarterly F24 for bolli (GET /api/bolli/f24) and the 'Prepara F24' button on /bolli-virtuali. Backend: 9/9 new pytest tests pass. They check: PDF content type and attachment filename F24_bolli_YYYY_Tn.pdf; codice tributo 2522/2524 matching the quarter; anno di riferimento; importo equal to the report quarter (bozza and scartata excluded); company CF (distinct from P.IVA) and denominazione; the default bank (predefinita, not the first in the list) with IBAN/ABI; scadenza moved to the next working day (2025-02-28 Sat -> 02/03 and 31/05 Sun -> 01/06 logic); and the bolli note instead of the IVA note. Also: 400 'Nessun bollo virtuale...' for empty quarters or draft-only quarters; 422 for trimestre 0/5, anno 1990 or missing params; company isolation; operatore allowed on own company and denied on another; 403 with fatture_attive off and with menu bolli-virtuali off; company without banks still renders. Regression: iteration33 F24 IVA and iteration60 bollo suites all pass. build_pdf without nota keeps the default IVA note. UI (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): the bolli-f24-btn-n button shows only on quarters with importo > 0 (2026: Q4 only; 2025: Q2 and Q4). Clicking it downloads F24_bolli_2026_T4.pdf and F24_bolli_2025_T2.pdf. No errors.

issues: The card shows the raw legal deadline ('entro 31/05/2026', 'entro 28/02/2027'). The generated F24 uses the next working day (01/06/2026, 01/03/2027). Consider showing the adjusted date, or a note, so the card and the PDF match.

action_items: Optional: show the working-day-adjusted scadenza on the quarter cards so they match the F24 PDF

Optional/test-maintenance: tests/test_iteration42_diritti_ritenute.py TestRitenute fails because party creation now needs codice_fiscale (a test-data problem, not a regression), so the ritenute F24 endpoint was not re-run end to end. build_pdf default-note behaviour is covered by a unit test.
critical_code_review_comments: bolli_f24 reuses bolli_report, so the F24 importo always matches the report. It reads every bollo doc of the year to build one quarter, which is fine at this scale.
The note hardcodes 'x 2,00 €' while the importo uses bollo_importo per document. The text would be wrong if bollo_importo ever differed from 2. Minor.
The 'rateazione' column is filled only for 6099, which is correct: it stays empty for 252x codes.
test_credentials: Used TEST_T61 admin/operatore sessions created via mongosh. The admin account from /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not touched.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T61 companies, parties and invoices (API-created and sent, plus mongo-inserted docs for the previous year) were created per run and deleted by company id. Verified 0 leftovers.
